architecture.mechanism: Stress corrosion cracking of stainless steel caused by chloride ions in cooling water
architecture.intervention: Implement a chloride ion monitoring system and maintain chloride levels below the threshold that causes stress corrosion cracking in stainless steel
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced biofilm and scale accumulation by minimizing chloride-induced corrosion that provides attachment sites for microbial growth
architecture.falsification_test: Compare heat transfer coefficients and pressure drops in two identical heat exchangers, one with controlled chloride levels and one without, over a 12-month period
